# NVIDIA Audio2Face protocol

Unmodified dependency closure of `nvidia_ace.services.a2f_controller.v1.proto` from NVIDIA/Audio2Face-3D-Samples at commit `a2d0150043be7dc15db2fad8193a78b660e1100f`.

Source: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Audio2Face-3D-Samples/tree/a2d0150043be7dc15db2fad8193a78b660e1100f/proto/protobuf_files

Apache-2.0, NVIDIA copyright notices retained in each file; license included. These are protocol definitions, not the licensed model or container. The adapter calls ProcessAudioStream, sends PCM metadata/chunks/EndOfAudio, and consumes named ARKit blendshapes and final status. No model weights are included.
